desc: a new account's home starts at zero (S14z of the world, SEAMLESS.md 19.24, question 36 (b)): a new account (no online story, no character) plays its lobby on its own empty story while another player's instance runs; its first own progress starts its online story at revision 1, nothing of the other's story reaches it

db_checks.name: the new account's own story started from zero
db_checks.sql: SELECT revision FROM online_story WHERE account_id = {id:n}

db_checks.name: no story history row copied from another account
db_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM online_story_history WHERE account_id = {id:n} AND reason NOT IN ('room', 'session')
